name: Scalp Massager (1N)
subtitle: A Head Massager for Men for Hair Growth & Health
metaDescription: Improve scalp circulation and reduce stress with a flexible scalp massager. Enhances serum absorption and supports healthy hair growth.

ingredients.name: Medical Grade Silicone
ingredients.shortDesc: Bristles made out of Medical Grade Silicone are gentle on the scalp and deep cleanse your hair without any harm
ingredients.longDesc: Bristles made out of Medical Grade Silicone are gentle on the scalp and deep cleanse your hair without any harm. They are also resistant to bacterial buildup. Best part? These bristles are very durable!.

ingredients.name: Ergonomic Design
ingredients.shortDesc: We've made this brush with a comfortable handle so that it's easy to use and hold
ingredients.longDesc: We've made this brush with a comfortable handle so that it's easy to use and hold. The ergonomic design makes it the perfect accessory to elevate every bath.

howToUse: If you're using this with a shampoo: Apply the shampoo. Take the massager and rub it in circular motions. If you're using a conditioner or hair mask: Apply the conditioner or hair mask and massage gently for thorough application. Storage Instructions: Once done, wash and leave it to air dry.

faqs.question: Can I use this scalp massager twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, this scalp massager can be used anytime you have a bath.

faqs.question: Can I dry it out in the sunlight?
faqs.answer: Yes, this scalp massager is safe to dry under the sun.
